caption: The drawing features a single object, a bonnet, placed against a plain, off-white background with no other items present. The bonnet is primarily brown with visible quilted stitching and texture throughout its surface, giving a sense of its fabric construction. The bonnet's edges are accented with a light blue trim, which also appears on the inside lining, contrasting with the brown exterior. The blue interior material has a slightly translucent quality, showing faint folds and creases. The bonnet occupies the central part of the composition, angled so that both the outside and some of the inside are visible, with a rounded crown and a brim that extends outward. The lighting on the bonnet suggests subtle shadows, providing depth and definition to the object.
title: Child's Bonnet
